beats.text: Good sex keeps working for two whole days.
Over two hundred newlywed couples kept a diary for two weeks, every single night.
After sex, satisfaction stayed higher for about forty-eight hours.
That held for men and women, younger and older.
And couples with a stronger afterglow were happier months later. Their satisfaction dropped less over time.
So it's not just one night. It's a two-day glow. Worth keeping warm.

sources: Meltzer, Makhanova, Hicks, French, McNulty & Bradbury (2017). Quantifying the sexual afterglow: The lingering benefits of sex and their implications for pair-bonded relationships. Psychological Science 28(5). Two samples of 96 and 118 newlywed couples, 14-day diaries; sexual satisfaction elevated ~48 h after sex; stronger afterglow predicted higher marital satisfaction and less decline 4-6 months later. Via APS press release.
